cases.title: Scanners & traceability
cases.subtitle: Automated batch identification on packing lines
problem: No full traceability of batches and operators at critical steps.
Reports scattered across many spreadsheets and files.
No quality evidence when handling complaints.
solution: Sensors and scanners on key stations, mapping batches and operators.
Integration with scales and labels, real-time event logging.
Traceability dashboard in the web app with batch history.
result: Complete batch path available in seconds.
Fewer labeling errors and fewer manual fixes.
Faster responses to audits and customer claims.

cases.title: OEE and downtime
cases.subtitle: Machine monitoring and maintenance alerts
problem: Low OEE and no live visibility of downtime.
Manual reports delay reactions to failures.
No data to plan maintenance effectively.
solution: OEE module with machine status sensors and automatic downtime classification.
Alerts for failures and threshold breaches on downtime length.
OEE panel with event timeline and filters for shifts and cells.
result: Faster reaction to failures and shorter unplanned stops.
Better maintenance planning using failure history.
A single source of truth for OEE and event history.

cases.title: ERP/MES/WMS integration
cases.subtitle: API hub for production and warehouse sync
problem: Order, production and inventory data spread across systems.
Delays in updating inventory after production finishes.
High risk of manual data entry errors.
solution: API hub connecting ERP, MES and WMS with bidirectional sync.
Process map: orders → production → receipts and issues.
Validations and queues for resilience to temporary outages.
result: Consistent data across orders, production and warehouse.
Fewer manual corrections and inventory mismatches.
Ready for financial and quality reporting near real time.

value1.title: Industrial automation experts
value1.description: We are a team of practitioners who bridge the world of sensors and PLC controllers with modern software. Thanks to hundreds of deployments, we take full responsibility for the stability, safety, and performance of your production lines.
highlights: Interdisciplinary team – experts in automation, robotics, and IT working towards one goal.
360° support – from audit and sensor selection, to installation, programming, and service.
Industry 4.0 standards – we design systems with 24/7 operation in the most demanding conditions in mind.

value2.title: Dedicated AI agents for industry
value2.description: We create specialized AI agents that learn the unique characteristics of your facility and processes. We assign them specific operational roles, making them real-time digital support for your team.
highlights: Intelligent analysis and reporting – automatic generation of insights from large datasets.
Anomaly and aberration detection – immediate identification of even the smallest deviations from the norm.
Process adaptation – AI modeling tailored to specific machines and production lines.

value3.title: Dynamic analytics and reporting
value3.description: We deliver tools that transform raw data into readable business insights. Our systems enable full view personalization and documentation automation, giving you full visibility into your facility's condition at any time.
highlights: PDF reports on demand – automatic generation of detailed summaries and reports for any selected period.
Interactive dashboards – flexible charts with "drill-down" functionality, enabling view customization and deep data analysis.
AI-powered insights – intelligent trend summaries that suggest what to focus on in the coming week.

value4.title: Iterative implementation & partnership
value4.description: We deliver projects in stages, ensuring a smooth transition from concept to full implementation. We bridge the worlds of automation and IT, delivering functionalities that we jointly design and verify at every step.
highlights: Safe staging – full testing of automation and code before launch.
Transparent process – constant contact and ongoing discussion of functionalities.
Custom solutions – systems precisely tailored to measure.

value5.title: Developers passionate about improvements
value5.description: We build a team of experienced software engineers who deeply understand the dynamics of modern industry. Our systems combine Enterprise-class reliability with modern UI/UX standards, delivering tools that employees simply enjoy using.
highlights: Direct dialogue with creators – you design functionalities and app appearance in constant contact with our developers.
Intuitiveness and ergonomics – we focus on simplicity of use, so system deployment in the team is quick and hassle-free.
Versatility and stability – we build flexible solutions that maintain the highest performance under heavy data load.

value6.title: Scalability and Future-Ready Systems
value6.description: We design solutions with the future of your facility in mind. Our architecture is modular, allowing for rapid expansion of the system with new production lines, machines, or sensors without the need to rebuild the entire IT foundation.
highlights: Modular construction – freely adding new functionalities and workstations as the company grows.
Openness to integrations – easy connectivity with your existing ERP, CRM, or warehouse systems.
Technological longevity – we use technology stacks that will be supported for decades.
